title: startRun re-checks that the project is still registered

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S38 reviewer note, accepted as a limit. A run planned before ork projects rm can still launch for the removed project, because startRun (internal/daemon/runs.go ~:403) does not re-check that the project is registered; the handlers.go comment on projects.rm says so. Together with S35 (removed-project runs stay visible) and S77 (queued runs of a removed project stop) this closes the gap.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/daemon/runs.go` (startRun, the admission registry read near :486): after the fresh read under runs.mu, refuse with notFound when plan.project.Name is not in the registry.
- `internal/daemon/runs_test.go`: the tests.
- `internal/daemon/handlers.go` (removeProject, the comment near :430-431): drop "Planned starts are not covered".
- `docs/design.md` (projects rm near :1097): say a start that loses the race to rm is refused.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestStartRunRefusesAProjectRemovedAfterPlanning: a fake Slicer whose RecommendRoles (called by planRun, outside runs.mu) removes the project from the registry file; startRun then fails with not_found naming the project, and no worktree, no run record and no engine are created.
- TestStartRunStillAdmitsARegisteredProject: the same flow without the removal still starts (guards against refusing everything).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Tests first; watch the first fail because startRun admits the removed project.
2. In startRun, after `f, err := d.loadRunRegistryLocked()` succeeds, look up plan.project.Name with find(f, ...) and return notFound(name, f) when missing, before engine.New. removeProject holds runs.mu through Save, so this check under runs.mu closes the race.
3. Keep the existing behaviour: an unreadable registry still refuses admission (no cache fallback; "Admission still requires a fresh read", runs.go loadRunRegistryLocked comment).
4. Update the handlers.go comment and docs/design.md.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/daemon
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- slicer check
- adj lint
